set.body:
Expose bounded catalog search through the application, HTTP API and Home screen, using authorized release records for every returned field and aggregate.

Acceptance criteria

1. A steward and an authorized reader can find the protocol archive using descriptor-only words such as ‘fictional lab records’. A BIDS release is discoverable through the same interaction.
2. A caller holding only R1 sees the R1 record. Changes unique to R2 or a hidden project leave that caller’s records, snippets, totals, any facets, and page boundaries unchanged.
3. Discovery-only, metadata-only link access, expired and revoked grants follow the field/permission matrix from ARC02. Blank, no-match and restart cases have usable browser outcomes.
4. An integration test compares paged PostgreSQL results with a reference oracle including two same-titled deposits and a private description.

Verification

Retain packaged API responses and browser steps starting at Home. Verify positive matches and hidden-field canaries.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC04: Search permitted release descriptions from Home
